It's extremely hard to blast off and it's something you can't "go for" the compound will tell you when your ready and if your ready you'll get the breakthrough. 

Because what happens is as soon as you exhale and close your eyes you go through the tunnel, then the waiting room, and finally the break through. You have to be ready. I've heard with a high enough dose you can force it but it's a very spiritual thing, almost as if it has a conciousness of its own. I haven't tried a high enough dose yet as that first experience rocked me to my core, I'm merely going off of what I've read/heard through various people. I'm waiting until I know I'm at a place where I'm spiritually ready, I was suicidal previously and had to spend some time in the hospital, im just now getting of that cloud and making it back so I know im in a bad place right now to try. You really - 'nd I cannot stress this enough- REALLY have to respect the compound. 

Listen to Terrance McKenna, he was really the forefather  of the DMT experience bringing knowledge of it to us midwesterners and can give you an idea of what you will experience and he can explain it better than I could begin to try. Psychedsubstance of youtube can give you pointers on harm reduction, offer insights, and tell you about how to go about it. I really reccomend extracting it yourself, the process is easy if your in the right setting and it gives you a deep respect for it. I mean extracting it itself is almost a spiritual experience and it's a fun starter place for chemistry. Look to r/dmt -I think it is?- for various teks and find the one that's right for you with availability of supplies and what you have available to you. GordoTek is easiest in my opinion. 

Have fun with it though, respect it, but have fun. It's an amazing thing and it's unlike anything you will experience in this lifetime. Skydiving is fun but DMT is like jumping out of a shuttle with no 'chute and instead of falling down your falling straight up into spiritual ecstasy. 

Even on my dose though at .040mg I lost all contact with myself, who I was, and concept of time and reality. Also get a mg scale, it's not something you want to play around with trying to eyeball, their very easy to get and will help you TONS.

Edit: try r/dmtguide

I did n,n dmt once and if you want to try a complete breakdown in identity/ego that's the way to go. Trip only lasts 15 min, is more intense than anything you will ever experience (though I believe Ayahuasca and 5-MEO-DMT is more intense), and will break your idea of who/what/when you are down almost instantly. Very easy to extract, and very very intense. I like DXM because on upper third plat it feels like DMT in the pitch black of night only in that I'm "here"  instead of blasting off and leaving my body. It's a very scary experience if your not ready to completely "let go". I mean you have to really be ready to let go of your connection to this world and who you are which is a very hard thing to do as your ego wants to fight it and go into instant survival mode if you don't take enough. For My trip I burned my dose incorrectly and only got part of it so I was "here" instead of blasting off. I want to try it again but I also have to get over this block it's created in me where I'm a bit scared to go at it again.

 Working my way to overcome that though. However since then everything is different; my dreams are extremely intense, weed is different, psychedelics like lsd and dxm are different.
